planned_lines: Let's pay our respects
to those lost at sea.
"The sea and a mother are alike.
The lapping waves sound strangely
familiar, like the distant echo
of a mother's heartbeat.
The sea and a mother are alike.
In some lands, they say, both may
be written and spoken the same way.
You're right. I took you for an
old fellow who just liked ships.
You've got real talent.
Hmm. A big trading network?
I'd look in or near
the major cities of each region.
Some of the locals may know. First,
you'll have to earn their trust.
Do favors for the townspeople. Help
them out of trouble. If crooked
merchants or soldiers prey on them,
teach them a lesson...
Whew... It's hard to become the one
who rules the seas.
Ha ha ha! Of course it is. No one's
ever done it.
At the Palace or Governor's Office,
pay the local ruler a contract fee
for the right to trade in town.
Get contracts in different towns.
The minimum fee should be enough
at first.
I arranged the contract in Ceuta.
You'll handle the others yourself.
All right. If you have anything
you want to sell, go ahead.
First thing a sailor needs
in the Caribbean is a glass of rum!
Come on, let's go to the tavern.
Aaaah! An earthquake! A fire! It's
the end of the world!
He calls himself
the 'Blast Wizard,' or some
such nonsense.
Blast Wizard? What an awful name.
There's a factory outside town.
An odd fellow lives there.
He studies explosives and cannons.
He makes that racket now and then.
Well, bombs aren't the same
as cannons. Then again, I suppose
they're not so different.
Oh! You're sailors? Would you take
him somewhere else?
Oh! Just what I've been hoping...
I mean, I'm sure he'll
be a great help to you!
Never mind that! You've done
it again today!
I told you before, it's
not a failure! I'm this close
to making it work. Besides...
All right, all right! I get it.
I didn't come here to complain.
I'll leave you to it.
See you, Charles!
Science must be too hard for him.
I can't blame him
for not getting it.
If you ask me, you're the one who
doesn't make sense.
Hmm... You hardly look scholarly.
I don't suppose you're sponsors.
Ah, sailors! I see... Tell me,
are you interested in science?
It's wonderful just thinking about
it! Sailing really is a science!
You sound like you know something
about the map to the Proof.
I do. But I can't tell just anyone.
You're afraid of what someone with
evil intentions might do with it?
I'm certain this young man has what
it takes to rule the seas.
They say the clan guarding
the map in China fled
the rulers of the day and traveled
far, far to the northeast.
Find the base of the vast
peninsula. On its eastern coast,
look at the foot of a high peak.
